integrity: Exact cofactor algebra and differentiability proof; independent validation not performed. An inaccessible relevant 2001 article and potentially broader allocation theorems limit historical-priority certainty.
scientific_limitations: Two-patch, time-homogeneous continuous-time occupancy Markov model with strictly positive external colonization; not valid for absorbing systems, multi-patch networks, demographic counts, or empirical management without model checks.
title: Two distinct directional-colonization budgets in a two-patch occupancy chain
